data.description: 美羽在窗边坐下，将点好的饮料放在桌上，望了一会儿外面的街道。
data.action: sitting beside the window with a drink on the table
data.promptProse: Seated at a round table on a quayside cafe terrace, Miu holds a porcelain coffee cup with both hands, turning to look toward the viewer with a gentle smile. Soft morning sunlight illuminates the striped terrace awning and the calm harbor water in the distance.
